scope: Supply and install a 4.4 kWp solar PV system (10 x 440 W panels) on the south-facing roof, with a 5 kWh battery and hybrid inverter in the garage. Includes scaffold, DNO notification, commissioning and the MCS certificate needed for Smart Export Guarantee payments.

items.description: Mounting kit, isolators, cabling and generation meter
DNO notification, commissioning and MCS certificate

notes: 0% VAT: installing solar panels and batteries in a home is zero-rated in Great Britain until 31 March 2027 (HMRC energy-saving materials relief), so no VAT is added. Estimated generation is about 3,700 kWh a year; actual output depends on shading and weather. 25% deposit on acceptance, balance on commissioning.
